result.theorem: ∀ x. ∀ y. (∃ z. x = S z ∧ y = z + z) → ∃ z. y = z + z ∧ x = S z
goals: ⊢ ∀ x. ∀ y. (∃ z. x = S z ∧ y = z + z) → ∃ z. y = z + z ∧ x = S z
